versions.subject: Windows redcannary rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \findstr.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - cpassword 
        - \sysvol\
        - .xml
condition: selection

versions.subject: feat: update cmd based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\findstr.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'FINDSTR.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cpassword'
        - '\sysvol\'
        - '.xml'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\findstr.exe" OR OriginalFileName="FINDSTR.EXE" CommandLine="*cpassword*" CommandLine="*\\sysvol\\*" CommandLine="*.xml*"

versions.subject: Fix Further FPs Found In Testing (#4564)

          - '\find.exe'

selection_cli:

        - '\sysvol\'
        - '.xml'
